summary: Seven days from the hard deadline the thesis remains defensible as a methodology/prototype thesis. Forty+ tightening commits since the previous review removed local redundancy and stale glosses, and contribution (a) is now framed as a pipeline with an example model rather than a finished product. The statistical-reporting contract from §1.50-69 is now genuinely honored in §2 result tables (Wilson + Poisson CIs appear on the major recall/FAPH tables). What did not move: the introduction still asks the FAPH < 1 / recall >= 0.95 success question and presents three parallel contributions, the user-test dataset is still not formed, the threshold-freeze file is still a pilot candidate, and small polish items (corpus'tel typo, PROJECT_TODO T-11/T-14 header drift, 9 overfull-hbox warnings, stale built PDF) persist. The headline risk going into the last week is unchanged: if no participant data lands, the safest defense story is methodology-as-primary and v16c-as-case-study, but the intro still invites a product-readiness reading.
top_strengths: Contribution (a) reframed as `reprodutseeritav eestikeelse äratussõna treening- ja hindamistoru koos näidismudeliga` — closer to the abstract's framing (introduction.tex:17).
Statistical contract from first_chapter.tex:58 is consistently honored in second_chapter.tex result tables (Wilson 95% UV for recall, Poisson/Garwood + rule-of-three for FAPH).

§3.7 (sec:eval-evolution) explicitly names the multidimensional validation protocol as the strongest defended contribution (third_chapter.tex:88) and §3.7.3 honestly distinguishes 'methodology is the contribution' from 'first Estonian wake word' (third_chapter.tex:120-121).

Honest scoping retained: §2.user-test-results-status still states the 20-30 participant dataset is not formed (second_chapter.tex:675), §3.benchmark-gap explicitly softens to 'piiratud tõendus' with 'kasutajatestimine vajalik täiendus, mitte asendaja' (third_chapter.tex:38).
Audit-ring methodology unchanged and still strong: three-round narrative covers data leakage, positive-label audit, and composite checkpoint criterion.
top_risks: Introduction still frames the work with FAPH < 1 and recall >= 0.95 as the deciding sub-question and lists model/method/integration as parallel contributions — invites a product-readiness reading the rest of the thesis does not support.

User-test evidence is still absent at T-7. With one week left, the realistic plan is one self-pilot + 2-3 friend pilots; a 20-30 participant study cannot complete + analyze + write up by 2026-05-18. The thesis text correctly hedges, but the abstracts/intro still mention 'kasutajauuring on piiratud mahus' rather than 'kasutajauuring on piirangute peatükis kirjeldatud kavandatav järelkiht'.
Threshold freeze remains a pilot candidate (frozen-threshold-policy.md:3) — only blocking if user-test rows are added; otherwise should be reframed as scoped-out.
PROJECT_TODO.md is dated 2026-05-10 but still has the 'T-14 days, ordered' subhead under a 'T-11 days' top heading — minor inconsistency, but visible in the file most automation reads.
Build artifact is stale: docs/thesis/thesis-tex-estonian/main.pdf last built 2026-05-07 22:20; 40+ commits later the PDF does not reflect current source. main.log shows 9 overfull-hbox warnings.

The rest of the thesis (abstract, §3.7) frames this as one of several criteria in a multidimensional protocol, not a binary success target.

If the user-test stays as 'planned' this is acceptable, but the thesis text should still cite the planned consent procedure.

soft_critique_answers.strongest_actual_contribution: Multidimensional validation protocol for low-resource keyword spotting: independent streaming FAPH + held-out real-speaker recall + similar-negatives/prefix/confusable FPR reported together, demonstrated via the three audit rings (data leakage, positive-label, composite checkpoint).
soft_critique_answers.biggest_current_risk: Intro framing vs. evidence mismatch — the intro still asks whether the model meets FAPH < 1 + recall >= 0.95, while no current model meets all deploy criteria simultaneously and user-test data will not arrive in time to settle the question.
soft_critique_answers.most_likely_overclaim: Implicit claim that 'first Estonian wake word' is a primary contribution. §3.7.3 explicitly denies this in favor of methodology, but the intro and the kratt-named artifact still read as a finished model.
soft_critique_answers.most_likely_committee_question: If the user test was central to the methodology design and is repeatedly referenced in §1.5 and §3.7.4, why is no participant data presented, and what exactly does the thesis claim instead?
soft_critique_answers.highest_roi_next_step: Rewrite introduction.tex:9-17 so sub-question 4 reads as 'milline mõõdikute kogum eristab tugevat mudelit lühitee-mudelist' rather than a binary FAPH/recall target, and reorder contributions so methodology is (a). One self-contained edit; large defense-readiness payoff.

probable_questions: Why are FAPH < 1 and recall >= 0.95 still in the introduction if you defend methodology as the primary contribution?
Where is the user-test evidence the methodology section so heavily references?
Why is the threshold-freeze document still a 'pilot candidate' on the day of submission?
Given v16c's high confusable/prefix FPR, why is it the active demo baseline rather than the MoE consensus that achieved 0.79 FAPH?
What does the Estonian wake-word community actually inherit from this work if no model is claimed as production-ready?
weak_answers_if_unfixed: Answering 'we kept the operational target for transparency' will only land if the answer explicitly demotes it from a success criterion to a deployment criterion.
Without a polished 'methodology is the contribution' one-liner, the user-test absence will dominate Q&A.
Without a scoped-out freeze document, the threshold-freeze question becomes a Gotcha rather than a non-issue.
suggested_preparation: Rehearse a single 90-second answer: 'Töö kaitstav panus on mitmemõõtmeline hindamisprotokoll, mida prototüüp Kratt v16c illustreerib. Kasutajatest on kavandatav neljas valideerimiskiht, mitte tõestatud panus; selle puudumine on dokumenteeritud piirang, mitte väite kandev kiht.'
Have the §3.7 (sec:eval-evolution) page tabbed and the three audit rings memorized.
Have a one-paragraph answer ready for 'why not freeze thresholds without user-test data' — i.e. they only need to be frozen if user-test rows are being claimed.

P0 (today): rebuild main.pdf and skim for overfull-hbox lines now flagged in main.log (9 cases) — these are likely 1-2 character fixes.

P1 (this week): align PROJECT_TODO.md header (T-11 vs T-14) and abstract-estonian.tex's 'piiratud mahus kasutajauuring' wording with whichever decision above is taken.
